Recurring limit: active recurring messages for the channel, again shared. Premium is per channel: if any admin activates Premium, the channel gets the Premium limits for everyone who uses it, while your other channels stay unaffected. This prevents the classic free-plan loophole where several admins each connect the same channel to multiply the free limits — the quota is on the channel itself.

## Permissions & Requests
URL: https://fastschedulebot.github.io/Fast-Schedule/help/a/admins_permissions.html

The Main Owner manages an RBAC-style permission list for every admin of the channel. What can be controlled: • Scheduling messages • Creating recurring messages • Viewing statistics • Leaderboard access • Exporting data • Managing messages (edit/delete) • Managing sender bots Editing: the owner opens an admin's profile and toggles permissions. Changes are collected into a draft — press Save Changes to apply them, and the bot shows a clear summary of exactly what changed before notifying the affected admin. Leaving the editor with unsaved changes prompts you to save or discard. Immediate effect: as soon as permissions are saved, buttons for disabled features disappear from that admin's menu, and enabled ones appear. If the admin taps an old button anyway, the bot replies "You do not have permission…" with a Request permission from the admin button. Auto-revocation: if an admin is removed from the channel in Telegram, or loses the Post Messages permission, all their bot-side permissions are revoked automatically on the next check — no manual cleanup needed. Requests: an admin who lacks a permission can request it (optionally with an explanation). The owner receives a Yes/No request and can send back a reply when declining. Anti-spam: one request per permission per user per week. The owner can also switch off request notifications for a specific admin.

## Ownership Transfer
URL: https://fastschedulebot.github.io/Fast-Schedule/help/a/admins_transfer.html

Transferring the Main Owner role is deliberately protected by multiple confirmation layers. The flow: 1. The current Main Owner opens the target admin's profile and presses Make Main Owner . 2. The bot asks the owner to type a confirmation phrase exactly (GitHub-style), e.g. "I confirm that I transfer management of [channel] to [username]". 3. After the phrase is accepted, a final confirmation button appears — the transfer is not created until it's pressed. 4. A pending transfer request is sent to the target admin, who must accept or decline it. While pending: the current owner can cancel the request at any time, and it expires automatically after 24 hours . On accept: the ownership swap is performed atomically — the target becomes the new Main Owner, the old owner stays as a regular admin with full permissions, and both parties are notified. At every critical step the bot re-validates that the target is still a real admin with Post Messages permission.

# Premium

## Premium
URL: https://fastschedulebot.github.io/Fast-Schedule/help/a/premium.html



Q: How do I purchase Premium?
A: Step by step: 1. Click Premium on the main menu (or use /premium ) 2. Choose a plan: Monthly (auto-renewing), 3-month , 6-month , or Yearly (prepaid, one-time) 3. Select payment method: Telegram Stars (in-app purchase) 4. Follow the payment provider's instructions 5. Premium activates immediately after confirmation If not active after 5 min, see Premium Troubleshooting sub-topic.

Q: How do I cancel my Premium auto-renewal?
A: Step by step: 1. Click Premium on the main menu (or use /premium ) 2. Click ❌ Cancel Premium 3. Select a reason (optional) → confirm with ✅ Yes, Cancel Premium 4. Your Premium stays active until the paid period ends (Cancel applies to the auto-renewing monthly plan; prepaid 3/6-month and yearly plans never auto-renew.) 5. Changed your mind before it ends? Open Premium again and buy a plan — you are Premium again instantly.

Q: What happens when Premium expires (full timeline)?
A: Here is how the Premium expiry process works — from the moment your subscription ends to the final cleanup. Nothing is deleted in the first days; you have time to choose what to keep. ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ Before Expiry — What to Expect ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ • You will receive a notification a few days before your Premium ends • If auto-renew is on and the payment succeeds, nothing changes — you stay Premium • If payment fails or you cancel, the expiry timeline below begins on the last day of your paid period ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ Day 0 — Notification & Choose What to Keep ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ • You receive a detailed notification with the Choose What to Keep interactive menu • You select which channels , sender bots , recurring messages , and media storage boxes to keep within Free plan limits • How choosing works: each item has a toggle button — tap to mark Keep or Remove. Selecting a channel auto-selects its sender bot. When you finish, tap Save Selection • If you don't choose: the system keeps the most recent channel, its bot, the newest recurring message, and the newest media storage box automatically ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ Days 1-2 — Grace Period ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ • Everything works normally — all messages send to all channels • You can still change your keep choices if you want ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ Day 3 — First Warning ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ • Notification: "Messages will stop tomorrow" • All messages still sent today • Media deletion warning if you haven't picked a storage box to keep ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ Day 4 — Messages to Excess Channels Stop ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ • Messages to non-kept channels stop being sent • Kept channels continue normally — no disruption for what you chose to keep • Signatures are stripped from all sent messages (signatures are a Premium feature) • You get a prompt to download a full backup of your data as an importable .fsback file • What happens to non-chosen items: they are frozen (not deleted). Their scheduled messages are skipped but preserved. You can still export them ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ Days 14-15 — Mid-Wait Notices ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ • Day 14: "Disconnect in 3 weeks" notice • Day 15: Mid-wait reminder ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ Day 17 — Media Cleanup ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ • Non-kept media storages are permanently deleted • Your kept storage is trimmed to 100 newest items (videos kept first) ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ Day 35 + 12 Hours — Final Disconnect ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ • 12-hour warning on day 35 • After 12 hours: excess channels are disconnected , excess sender bot tokens are removed • All signatures are permanently deleted • Your account is now fully on the Free plan ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ How to Reactivate ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ At any point before the final disconnect: use /premium or click Premium → choose a plan → pay. Everything restores instantly — channels, bots, messages, and media. After final disconnect, you can still re-subscribe but need to reconnect channels manually. See also: Item Freezing and Premium Expiry topics below for more details.

Q: How do I choose which channels to keep on expiry?
A: On day 0 after expiry, you get an interactive Choose What to Keep menu. Each channel, sender bot, and recurring message has a toggle button — tap to mark Keep or Remove. How it works: • Selecting a channel auto-selects its assigned sender bot • You can only keep as many items as the Free plan allows (e.g., 1 channel, 1 bot, 1 recurring message) • Once done, tap Save Selection • Then you choose a media storage box to keep (you can keep 1 box) If you don't choose: the system auto-selects the most recent channel, its bot, the newest recurring message, and the newest media storage box. See Item Freezing below for what happens to items you don't select.

Q: Will my media be deleted when Premium expires?
A: Media you choose to keep is safe. On day 0 you pick 1 storage to keep. Day 3 is a final warning. Day 17: excess storages are permanently deleted . Your kept storage is trimmed to 100 newest items (videos first, then newest). To keep everything: renew Premium with /premium before day 17.

Q: What is Signatures and how do I use it?
A: Add a signature once and every post in that channel carries it: send /signature (or tap 📝 Signature on the review screen), pick the channel, and send the text. Manage or remove it any time from the same menu.

Q: How do I earn free Premium days?
A: Use the Referral Program to invite friends, or redeem a Promo Code.

Open Premium for the full comparison.

Fast Scheduler Premium is paid with Telegram Stars — in-app purchase, instant, no card details needed. Monthly Stars plans renew automatically until cancelled; 3-month, 6-month, and yearly Stars plans are one-time purchases. See the sub-topics for details.

## Telegram Stars
URL: https://fastschedulebot.github.io/Fast-Schedule/help/a/payment_stars.html

Pay with Telegram Stars — the built-in Telegram currency. 1. Go to /premium and choose a plan 2. Select Telegram Stars 3. Confirm in the native Telegram payment window Plan behaviour: the monthly subscription renews automatically until cancelled; 3-month, 6-month, and yearly prepaid plans are one-time purchases (with up-front discounts on 3/6 months) and never auto-renew. Activation is instant. Buying Stars is done inside Telegram; the bot never handles your card.

## Crypto
URL: https://fastschedulebot.github.io/Fast-Schedule/help/a/payment_crypto.html

Crypto payments are currently unavailable . Premium is paid with Telegram Stars — choose any plan in /premium and confirm the Stars invoice. See Payments for details.

## Currencies
URL: https://fastschedulebot.github.io/Fast-Schedule/help/a/payment_currencies.html

Supported payment currency: • Telegram Stars: in-app currency, used directly in Telegram The final price is always shown to you before you confirm the payment.

## Pay Invoice
URL: https://fastschedulebot.github.io/Fast-Schedule/help/a/payment_invoice_pay.html

An invoice is the payment request the bot generates when you buy Premium. To pay an invoice: • Open the invoice message • Tap Pay • Confirm the Stars purchase in Telegram • Confirm — Premium activates once approved If an invoice expires, simply start a new one from /premium .

## Confirmation
URL: https://fastschedulebot.github.io/Fast-Schedule/help/a/payment_confirm.html

After paying, your account should upgrade within seconds. If Premium doesn't activate after 5 minutes: • Check the payment status with /premium • Some providers take up to a few minutes to confirm • If it stays inactive, contact support with your user ID and the payment receipt Do not pay twice — duplicate payments are handled manually via support.

## Payment Status
URL: https://fastschedulebot.github.io/Fast-Schedule/help/a/payment_status.html

Check your payment and Premium status at any time: • Open /premium — it shows your plan, expiry date, and usage • Stars purchases appear in your Telegram Stars settings If status doesn't update after a successful payment, contact support with your user ID.

## Apply Promo
URL: https://fastschedulebot.github.io/Fast-Schedule/help/a/payment_promo_apply.html

Use a promo code to get extra Premium days or a discount. 1. Open /premium 2. Choose Redeem Promo Code 3. Enter the code exactly as provided 4. The bonus is applied to your account Codes are single-use and may have a deadline. Invalid or expired codes show an error — double-check the spelling.

## Failed Payment
URL: https://fastschedulebot.github.io/Fast-Schedule/help/a/payment_failed.html

If a Stars payment fails or is declined: • Check your Telegram Stars balance covers the price • Wait a few minutes and retry — app-store billing can hiccup on rapid retries • Reopen /premium and start a fresh invoice If you were charged but Premium did not activate, contact support with the receipt — refunds are reviewed case by case.

## Trial
URL: https://fastschedulebot.github.io/Fast-Schedule/help/a/premium_trial.html

Occasionally, the bot offers free Premium trial days or promo bonuses. Watch the Premium menu and official announcements for current promotions. Promo codes can be redeemed directly in the Premium menu. Trial/referral Premium behaves exactly like paid Premium - all features unlocked for the granted period.

## Welcome to Premium
URL: https://fastschedulebot.github.io/Fast-Schedule/help/a/premium_welcome.html

Your Premium is active! Here's what changed: • Raise your limits - and welcome to more. • Unlock signatures, leaderboards, and unlimited scheduling. Next steps: connect more channels and sender bots, try the new features, and explore the help topics for each one. Manage your subscription (cancel, re-enable, promo) anytime via /premium .

## Promo Codes
URL: https://fastschedulebot.github.io/Fast-Schedule/help/a/promocode.html

Promo codes give you a discount or bonus months on a Premium purchase. How to redeem: 1. Open Premium and choose a plan (monthly / 3-month / 6-month / yearly). 2. On the payment screen tap Apply promo code . 3. Enter the code exactly as provided — it is applied to the price immediately. The code stays attached to your account for its remaining months; you can remove it from the same payment screen. Codes are case-sensitive and each works once per user. Where to find them: official Fast Scheduler announcements and seasonal promotions.

## Cancel Premium
URL: https://fastschedulebot.github.io/Fast-Schedule/help/a/premium_cancel.html

Cancelling only stops auto-renewal — your Premium stays active until the paid period ends. How to cancel: 1. Open Premium → ❌ Cancel Premium . 2. Choose a reason (optional) and confirm with ✅ Yes, Cancel Premium . Changed your mind? Open Premium again and buy a plan — you are Premium again instantly. Cancel applies to the auto-renewing monthly plan. Prepaid 3-month, 6-month, and yearly plans never auto-renew — there is nothing to cancel; they simply end. If you don't renew after the period ends, the expiry process begins — see Premium Expiry .

## Premium Status
URL: https://fastschedulebot.github.io/Fast-Schedule/help/a/premium_status.html

The Premium menu shows your: • Plan (Monthly / 3-month / 6-month / Yearly) • Status (active, cancelled, expiring) • Expiry date • Payment method and auto-renew state • User ID (for support) Check it anytime with /premium - especially if you think Premium should be active but isn't.

## Frozen Assets
URL: https://fastschedulebot.github.io/Fast-Schedule/help/a/premium_freeze.html

When Premium expires, the assets that don't fit your free plan are frozen first and disconnected later - they are NOT deleted at once. What gets frozen: • Channels beyond the free limit stop receiving messages after day 3. • Sender bots of frozen channels are turned off. • Recurring messages beyond the free limit are paused. • Media storages you didn't choose are deleted on day 17. • Signatures are stripped from outgoing messages and removed at disconnect. What keeps working: • Your kept channel and its sender bot continue as normal. • Scheduled messages on the kept channel keep sending. • Your account, settings, language and referral days remain. Reactivate Premium before the final disconnect to unfreeze everything instantly.

## Premium Expiry
URL: https://fastschedulebot.github.io/Fast-Schedule/help/a/premium_expiry.html

When your Premium subscription ends, nothing is deleted on day one. You get a grace period, reminders, and a chance to choose what to keep. The timeline at a glance: • Before expiry: you receive reminders at 7, 3 and 1 day(s) left. • Day 0: a "Choose What to Keep" menu appears - pick up to 1 channel, 1 bot and 1 recurring message, plus (if you use it) the media storage box you want to keep. • Days 1-2: everything still works normally; you can change your choices. • Day 3: you get a final warning and an automatic backup file (.fsback). • Day 4: messages to the channels you did NOT keep stop sending. Your kept channel keeps working. • Day 17: media cleanup - non-kept storage boxes are deleted and the kept box is trimmed to 100 items (videos first). • Day 35 + 12 h: final warning, then excess channels and sender bots are disconnected and their data removed. Signatures are deleted. Good news: renew at any point before the final disconnect and everything restores instantly - channels, bots, messages and media. See the sub-topics below for the grace period, frozen assets, renewal and refunds.

## Grace Period
URL: https://fastschedulebot.github.io/Fast-Schedule/help/a/premium_grace.html

After your Premium expires you have a grace period before anything is limited. During it: • All messages keep sending to every channel. • Nothing is frozen or deleted yet. • You can still change your "keep" choices. • A renew prompt with pay again / change plan / cancel is shown. If you renew during the grace period, Premium is restored instantly and the expiry process is cancelled. After the grace period ends (day 3), the limits from your keep-selection start being applied.

## Renew
URL: https://fastschedulebot.github.io/Fast-Schedule/help/a/premium_renew.html

Renewing restores your full Premium account - usually instantly. How to renew: 1. Open Premium (main menu or /premium ). 2. Tap Pay Again or choose a plan. 3. Pay with Telegram Stars. 4. Premium activates immediately after payment confirms. If you're in the middle of the expiry process: • Before day 4: everything is restored, nothing is lost. • Between day 4 and day 35: excess channels/bots were frozen but still connected - they are restored. • After day 35: excess channels and bots were disconnected; you re-connect them manually after renewing. Auto-renew: monthly Stars plans renew automatically. Yearly Stars plans are one-time payments - you renew manually.

## Reactivate
URL: https://fastschedulebot.github.io/Fast-Schedule/help/a/premium_reactivate.html

Premium can be reactivated after it expires or even after the final disconnect. • Before the final disconnect (day 35+12h): open /premium , pay, and everything is restored automatically. • After the final disconnect: subscribe again, then re-connect your excess channels and sender bots manually - the bot will guide you through it. Your data that was within the free limits (kept channel, up to 100 scheduled messages, one recurring message) is never removed, so nothing you kept is lost.

## Refunds
URL: https://fastschedulebot.github.io/Fast-Schedule/help/a/premium_refund.html

Refunds for Premium payments are handled on a case-by-case basis. To request a refund, contact @MaximalXP with: • Your user ID (shown in /premium ). • The payment method and date. • The transaction ID or receipt, if available. • A short reason for the request. Refunds are reviewed individually and are not guaranteed. If a payment is reversed by your bank/provider, Premium is revoked automatically and your account may be restricted until the issue is resolved.

## Premium Troubleshooting
URL: https://fastschedulebot.github.io/Fast-Schedule/help/a/premium_troubleshooting.html

Paid but not active? • Wait 2-3 minutes (some providers are slow to confirm). • Reopen /premium to refresh. • Stars: check your purchase went through in your Stars balance. If still nothing after 5 minutes, contact @MaximalXP with your user ID, payment method, and transaction ID. Reversed payment? Premium is revoked automatically and your account may be restricted until resolved. Auto-renew not working? Only monthly Stars plans auto-renew. Prepaid 3-month, 6-month, and yearly plans are one-time - you renew manually.

## Premium Activation
URL: https://fastschedulebot.github.io/Fast-Schedule/help/a/premium_activate.html

Premium activates immediately once the payment is confirmed. If payment went through but Premium isn't active after 5 minutes: 1. Reopen /premium to refresh the status. 2. For Telegram Stars, verify the purchase in your Stars balance. 3. Contact @MaximalXP with your user ID, method, and transaction details. See Premium Troubleshooting for the full list of checks.

## Referral Bonus

Referral-bonus Premium days work exactly like paid Premium while they last. You earned them by inviting friends who connected a channel. If you already have paid Premium, referral days stay in your balance until your paid period ends — then activate them from the referral menu. Track your balance under Referrals .

## Invoices

When you choose a plan, the bot sends a payment invoice message. • Telegram Stars: the invoice is a Stars payment request - open it and confirm the purchase in Telegram. If the invoice was not completed, check your Stars balance and retry from Premium .

## Referral Program
URL: https://fastschedulebot.github.io/Fast-Schedule/help/a/premium_referral.html

Referral days are granted when a new user joins from your link, connects a channel, and creates a message. They work like paid Premium. If you're mid-subscription, the days stay in your balance until your paid period ends — then activate them yourself from the referral menu. Get your link and see earnings with /referral .

## Is Fast Scheduler Premium Worth It? An Honest Breakdown
URL: https://fastschedulebot.github.io/Fast-Schedule/help/a/qa_premium_worth.html

Premium costs $6.83 a month (or $68.03 a year) and removes the ceiling on almost everything Free limits. Here is an honest map of who needs which part. What Premium changes, concretely 3 channels, 3 sender bots — run a network (main channel, announcements, chat-announcements mirror) from one account. Unlimited scheduled queue and unlimited sends — no 100-post queue, no monthly cap on any channel. Unlimited recurring rules — and they never expire; Free's single rule stops after 365 days. Bigger media : uploads to 100 MB, video to up to 50MB, 20 storage boxes × 500 items with video allowed , plus 4K-photo handling and higher bitrate media that Free compresses harder. Signatures — a footer (credit, promo, hashtags) auto-appended to every post of a channel. Export &amp; Backup toolkit — .fsback / .fspback backups, JSON/CSV/TXT/RTF/ODT exports: own your content. Who does not need it One channel, a couple of posts a day, no video-heavy content — Free covers that indefinitely. Premium's first meaningful gate for such a setup would be the monthly send cap, and even that takes ~4 posts/day to hit. Who feels the difference on day one Multi-channel admins — the 3×3 pairing is the headline feature. Video channels — 25MB → 50MB video and video-in-storage change the workflow. Anyone whose content is their business — backups and full exports are the difference between “my queue” and “my archive”. Automation lovers — unlimited recurring rules turn the bot into a true publishing engine. Terms worth knowing Premium attaches to your Telegram account, covers all your channels at once, and can be paid with Telegram Stars. Multi-month terms cost less per month (3/6-month discounts), and if something goes wrong the refund policy is linked in the footer — premium status is visible any time with /premium .

Q: Does Premium apply to all my channels or per channel?
A: Per account. One subscription unlocks the higher limits for every channel you connect while it is active.

Q: What happens to my schedules when Premium expires?
A: Nothing is deleted. Limits revert to Free: extra channels/bots beyond 1×1 stop scheduling until you disconnect them or renew, the queue cap applies again, and recurring rules beyond the first pause.

Q: Can I pay with Telegram Stars?
A: Yes — Stars are billed at the official rate and are currently the only payment method. The Premium menu always shows current prices.

## How to Pay for Fast Scheduler Premium (Stars and What Happens After)
URL: https://fastschedulebot.github.io/Fast-Schedule/help/a/qa_pay_stars_crypto.html

Premium attaches to your Telegram account and covers every channel you connect while it is active. Payment lives in the bot's Premium menu and uses Telegram Stars only. Telegram Stars Stars are Telegram's in-app currency. The bot converts the USD price at the official rate and shows the exact Star amount before you confirm — buy Stars in Telegram if your balance is short, approve, and Premium activates the moment the invoice clears. Refunds of Stars purchases follow Telegram's own flow, which is also why the bot asks you to double-check the term before paying. Plan terms The monthly Stars plan renews automatically until cancelled. Prepaid 3-month, 6-month, and yearly plans are one-time purchases (with up-front 3/6-month discounts) and never auto-renew. Right after payment Premium flags appear instantly in the menus; /premium shows status and expiry date. If you paid but see no change: restart the bot with /start — status is refreshed on launch. Still stuck? /feedback with the payment date and method gets a human on it the same day. Terms, renewals, refunds Multi-month terms cost proportionally less (built-in 3/6-month discounts), and expiry is shown everywhere Premium matters. When a prepaid term ends, limits quietly return to Free — nothing is deleted. The refund policy is linked in the site footer; genuine failures (double payment, activation glitch) are refunded by support.

Q: Can I pay for a friend’s account?
A: Premium binds to the Telegram account that activates it. To gift Premium, have them open the Premium menu and pay there, or transfer Stars — the bot cannot attach Premium to a different account after payment.

Q: Will Premium renew automatically?
A: The monthly Stars plan renews automatically until cancelled. Prepaid 3-month, 6-month, and yearly plans never auto-renew — when one ends, limits revert to Free and you can extend any time from the Premium menu.

## Free vs Premium: Which Fast Scheduler Plan Fits Your Channel?
URL: https://fastschedulebot.github.io/Fast-Schedule/help/a/qa_which_plan.html

Feature tables tell you what differs; this tells you when it matters . Four questions decide the plan. 1. How many channels do you run? One channel works great on Free (1 channel, 1 sender bot). Two or three channels — or plans to get there — is the cleanest Premium trigger: Premium pairs 3 channels with 3 sender bots from one account. 2. How much do you post? Multiply daily posts by 30. Under ~90 sends/month, Free's 100-per-channel cap rarely bites. A 3+/day cadence, or channels where every send counts (news, trading, drops), wants Premium's unlimited sends and queue. 3. Is your content video-heavy? Free uploads top out at 10 MB with video at up to 25MB, no video in Media Storage, and stronger compression. If your posts live on video, Premium's 100 MB uploads, up to 50MB video, and video-in-storage are not a luxury — they are the workflow. 4. Do you need backups, exports or signatures? The Export &amp; Backup toolkit ( .fsback archives, JSON/CSV exports) and auto-signatures are Premium-only. If the queue is your business — client channels, monetized content — backups stop being optional the first time you restructure a month of posts. The short version Stay Free if: one channel, ≤3 posts/day, text-and-photo content, no archive needs. Go Premium if: 2–3 channels, 3+ posts/day, video content, recurring automation beyond one rule, or you want backups and signatures. Either way : you can start Free and upgrade the moment a limit touches you — nothing you built on Free breaks when Premium ends.

Q: Can I try Premium and go back to Free?
A: Yes. On expiry, limits revert to Free and nothing is deleted — disconnect extra channels if you keep more than one, and the first recurring rule keeps running.

Q: Does Premium change how fast posts send?
A: Send speed is the same — Telegram delivery does not differ by plan. Premium removes quantity limits and media compression, not latency.

## How Do I Get a Refund on My Fast Scheduler Premium Purchase?
URL: https://fastschedulebot.github.io/Fast-Schedule/help/a/qa_refund_how.html

Refunds are handled personally, not by a faceless form. If a purchase went wrong — a double charge, an accidental renewal, Premium that never activated — you write one email and a human sorts it out. Here is the whole procedure, step by step. What to send Email fastschedulebot@gmail.com with three things: Your transaction ID — Telegram shows it in the Stars payment confirmation and in Settings → Payments. Your Telegram username (or user ID) so the purchase can be matched to your account. The reason — one honest sentence is enough, plus the purchase date and the account or email used, where applicable. The 30-day window and what happens next Refund requests are accepted within 30 days of the charge. Requests are acknowledged within 7 business days , and approved refunds are returned through the original payment method — for Telegram Stars that means back to your Stars balance. Refunds are discretionary rather than guaranteed for every situation, which is exactly why a short, honest reason helps: accidental purchases and technical failures the team could not fix are the classic approved cases. Cancelling so you are not charged again Monthly Stars plans renew automatically until cancelled. You cancel inside the bot: open /premium → ❌ Cancel Premium . Cancelling stops future billing; the period you already paid for stays active until its end date, and Premium switches off at that boundary rather than mid-plan. The 3-month, 6-month and yearly packs are one-time purchases — they simply expire and never auto-charge. What not to do: chargebacks Opening a card or Apple/Google chargeback instead of emailing is treated as abuse: the account loses Premium immediately and the subscription fee is forfeited. Emailing first is always faster — most refund conversations end within a couple of messages. One more nuance: deleting your data or stopping use of the bot does not automatically refund anything, so if you want both, request the refund before asking for account deletion.

Q: How long does a Fast Scheduler refund take?
A: Requests are acknowledged within 7 business days. Once approved, Stars refunds return to your Telegram Stars balance; the total time depends on Telegram, typically a few days.

Q: Can I cancel Premium and keep it until the period ends?
A: Yes. Cancelling via /premium stops auto-renewal, and Premium stays active until the end of the paid period. Downgrade happens at that boundary, not immediately.

Q: I was charged twice. What do I do?
A: Email fastschedulebot@gmail.com with both transaction IDs and your Telegram username. Duplicate charges are the clearest refund case and are resolved quickly.

# Referrals

## Referrals
URL: https://fastschedulebot.github.io/Fast-Schedule/help/a/referral.html



Q: How do I get my referral link?
A: Go to Premium → Referral Program or use /referral. Your unique link is shown there.

Q: When do I get my Premium days?
A: After the referred user connects a channel and sends 1 message(s).

Q: Why must I connect a channel and schedule a message first?
A: Because rewards cost real money, we must verify every account is genuine before unlocking sharing. It takes two minutes: connect a channel and schedule one message. Full story: Why Verification Is Required.

## How Referrals Work
URL: https://fastschedulebot.github.io/Fast-Schedule/help/a/referral_how.html

1. Run /referral to get your personal link. 2. Share it with friends. 3. When a new user starts via your link, connects a channel , and creates at least 1 message, you earn Premium days. 4. Your friend also gets a bonus. Track everything from the referral menu.

## Your Link
URL: https://fastschedulebot.github.io/Fast-Schedule/help/a/referral_link.html

Your personal link is generated in /referral . Share it wherever your audience is: channels, groups, stories, or other bots. The link only credits you when a user is new to the bot. Tip: combine it with a promo code for maximum value.

## Share
URL: https://fastschedulebot.github.io/Fast-Schedule/help/a/referral_share.html

Promote your referral link where channel owners are: • Your channel posts and pins. • Telegram groups and comments. • Social media stories. The referred user gets a bonus too - mention that in your message for a higher conversion.

## Referral Rewards
URL: https://fastschedulebot.github.io/Fast-Schedule/help/a/referral_rewards.html

Each qualifying referral adds Premium days to your account, up to a 45-day total . • You earn days when the referred user connects a channel and creates a message. • If you already have paid Premium, earned days stay in your balance until your paid period ends — then activate them from the referral menu. • Referral Premium works like paid Premium. See your balance at any time with /referral .

## Activate Days
URL: https://fastschedulebot.github.io/Fast-Schedule/help/a/referral_activate.html

If you're on the free plan, activate your earned referral days from the referral menu - they start a Premium period immediately. If you already have paid Premium, the days stay in your balance; activate them from the referral menu once your paid period ends.

## Your Referral Stats
URL: https://fastschedulebot.github.io/Fast-Schedule/help/a/referral_stats.html

Your referral stats live in /referral : • Your personal referral link • How many users joined through it • Premium days earned, used and available • The list of referred users Everything updates automatically - when a new user qualifies, your available days grow by 3.

## Detailed Stats
URL: https://fastschedulebot.github.io/Fast-Schedule/help/a/referral_stats_detail.html

Open your referral menu with /referral to see how your program is going. • Referred users - how many people have joined through your link. • Earned days - the total Premium days your referrals have generated. • Available days - what you can activate right now. • Used days - the days already converted into Premium time. You can also expand the list of users who joined via your link right in the menu. Want more referrals? Share your link where channel owners hang out - that is the audience that converts.

## Referral History
URL: https://fastschedulebot.github.io/Fast-Schedule/help/a/referral_history.html

The referral menu lists everyone who joined through your link - expand it to see their names and usernames. Each qualifying referral adds 3 Premium days to your balance automatically; the menu shows your earned, used and available day totals so you always know where you stand. A referral qualifies when the new user connects a channel or creates a scheduled or recurring message.

## Rules
URL: https://fastschedulebot.github.io/Fast-Schedule/help/a/referral_rules.html

• The referred user must be new (never used the bot before). • They must use your link as their first interaction. • They must connect a channel and create at least 1 message. • One referral per user (no double crediting). • Max 45 premium days from referrals. Disputes? Contact @MaximalXP .

## Abuse
URL: https://fastschedulebot.github.io/Fast-Schedule/help/a/referral_fraud.html

Only genuine new users count. Referrals from accounts that never connect a channel or create a message don't qualify. Creating fake accounts to farm days isn't allowed and may result in the removal of earned days or account restrictions.

## Why Verification Is Required
URL: https://fastschedulebot.github.io/Fast-Schedule/help/a/referral_verify.html

To unlock the Referral Program you must connect a channel and schedule at least 1 message . This is not bureaucracy — it is how we verify your account is real. Why we do it. Every referral reward is paid out as Premium time, and Premium time costs us real money (Telegram Stars fees and server costs). Without verification, anyone could spin up dozens of empty accounts in minutes and drain the reward pool — which would force us to shut the program down for everyone, including honest users. What counts as verification. Connecting a channel proves you have something real to post to; scheduling a message proves you actually use the bot. Both checks are automatic and take most users under two minutes: send your channel link in Step 1 of the tutorial, then schedule any post — even a test message to yourself counts. What we check — and what we don't. We only look at anonymous counters (channels connected, messages created). We never read your message contents, never ask for documents or phone numbers, and never share anything with third parties. Verification is purely about activity, not identity. Common confusion. Opening the Referral menu before verifying shows a locked screen — that is expected, not a bug. Finish the two steps above and the menu unlocks by itself; nothing else is required.

## Beta Program
URL: https://fastschedulebot.github.io/Fast-Schedule/help/a/referral_beta.html

The Referral Program is currently in BETA . It works end to end — links, tracking, crediting and day activation are all live — but you may occasionally run into rough edges: a counter that updates with a delay, a list that needs a reopen to refresh, or a message that reads slightly differently from what you expected. Your earned days are safe. Beta status affects polish, never balances. Every qualifying referral is recorded the moment it happens, and Premium days, once earned, are never lost because of a display glitch. If something looks wrong, reopen the /referral menu first — most counters refresh on open. Help us finish it. If you spot an error, tell us through /feedback with what you did step by step and, if possible, a screenshot. Beta reporters directly shape the final version: unclear texts get rewritten and confusing flows get simplified because of your reports. What may change. Reward sizes, limits and rules can still be tuned while the program is in beta. Any change will be announced in the referral menu itself — earned balances are always honored under the rules that were live when they were earned.

## How Crediting Works
URL: https://fastschedulebot.github.io/Fast-Schedule/help/a/referral_credit.html

Here is exactly what happens from click to Premium days, for both sides. 1. Click. A new user opens your link and starts the bot. The click is recorded instantly, but nothing is granted yet — this is what the "pending" state in your list means. 2. Verify. The new user connects a channel and schedules at least 1 message — the same verification you completed to unlock the program. Until then, the referral stays pending. 3. Credit. The moment they qualify, both of you receive 3 Premium days : the days land in your referral balance (see them with /referral under Available days). If you already have paid Premium, the days wait in your balance until it ends. 4. Activate. On the free plan, activate earned days from the referral menu — a Premium period starts immediately. Used days move to the Used counter so you always see earned, used and available totals. Limits. Each user can generate referral rewards from up to 15 referees, i.e. a 45-day total. One referral per user — the same newcomer can never credit you twice, even if they click your link again.

# Limits

## Limits
URL: https://fastschedulebot.github.io/Fast-Schedule/help/a/limits.html

Fast Scheduler's plans differ in five numbers: pending scheduled messages, sends per month, recurring messages, channels, and sender bots. The bot counts them live — /stats always shows your current usage. • Free : 100 pending messages, 100 sends per channel per month, 1 recurring message, 1 channel, 1 sender bot. • Premium : unlimited pending and sent messages, unlimited recurring messages, 3 channels, 3 bots, plus larger media storage and longer videos. There is no daily cap on either plan — the only send quota on Free is monthly, and it resets on the 1st.

Q: How do I check my current usage?
A: Use /stats to see your real-time usage against plan limits.

## Free Plan Limits
URL: https://fastschedulebot.github.io/Fast-Schedule/help/a/limits_free.html

Your free account allows: • 1 connected channel • 1 sender bot • Up to 100 scheduled messages pending at once • 1 recurring message • 100 sent messages per channel per month • 1 media storage box, 100 items • Video uploads up to 25MB Check /stats for your current usage.

## Premium Plan Limits
URL: https://fastschedulebot.github.io/Fast-Schedule/help/a/limits_premium.html

Premium removes most caps: • 3 channels and 3 sender bots • Unlimited pending scheduled messages (100 on Free) and unlimited recurring messages • Unlimited sent messages (100 per channel per month on Free) • Up to 20 media storage boxes, unlimited items • Larger uploads: up to 50MB videos, 100 MB media • Videos allowed in storage (up to 50MB) • Signatures, leaderboards, unlimited report schedules If you downgrade, your data is kept but only the free allowances stay active until the expiry process removes the excess.

## Monthly Send Limit
URL: https://fastschedulebot.github.io/Fast-Schedule/help/a/limit_daily.html

There is no daily cap on the Free plan — you can schedule and send every day. The only send quota is monthly : Free plans can send up to 100 messages per channel per calendar month . The counter resets on the 1st. Check your usage in /stats . Premium removes the monthly cap entirely — unlimited sends.

## Scheduled Limit
URL: https://fastschedulebot.github.io/Fast-Schedule/help/a/limit_scheduled.html

Free plan stores up to 100 scheduled messages pending at once. Premium: unlimited. When you hit the limit, schedule another after deleting old ones (use Message List ). Past-dated messages that were sent are removed automatically. Check your count in /stats .

## Recurring Limit
URL: https://fastschedulebot.github.io/Fast-Schedule/help/a/limit_recurring.html

Free plan allows 1 recurring message. Premium: unlimited. Recurring messages expire after 365 days and are auto-removed, so create a new one when an old campaign ends. Manage them from Message List .

## Channel Limit
URL: https://fastschedulebot.github.io/Fast-Schedule/help/a/limit_channels.html

Free plan: 1 connected channel. Premium: up to 3 . Each channel can have its own sender bot, time zone, and signature. To add more channels, upgrade via /premium .

## Sender Bot Limit
URL: https://fastschedulebot.github.io/Fast-Schedule/help/a/limit_bots.html

Free plan: 1 sender bot. Premium: up to 3 . Each bot is tied to one channel. If you reach the limit, remove an unused bot or upgrade to Premium.

## Media Limit
URL: https://fastschedulebot.github.io/Fast-Schedule/help/a/limit_media.html

Media uploads are capped by your plan: • Max media size: 10 MB free / 100 MB premium • Video upload: up to 25MB free / up to 50MB premium • Video in storage: No free / up to 50MB premium • 4K media: — free / Yes premium Photos/videos are compressed automatically on upload (see Media Compression ).

## Storage Limit
URL: https://fastschedulebot.github.io/Fast-Schedule/help/a/limit_storage_detail.html

Free: 1 box / 100 items, no videos. Premium: 20 boxes / unlimited items, videos up to 50MB. Your storage menu shows current usage and the closest limit.

## Raise Limits
URL: https://fastschedulebot.github.io/Fast-Schedule/help/a/limit_increase.html

Most limits are raised by upgrading to Premium : • More channels, bots, media storage, and recurring messages. • More pending scheduled messages and unlimited monthly sends. • Larger files and videos. Some limits are fixed by design (e.g. one sender bot per channel, anonymous polls only in channels - enforced by Telegram). Open /premium to see current prices and raise your limits.

## Raise Channels
URL: https://fastschedulebot.github.io/Fast-Schedule/help/a/limit_raise_channels.html

Free: 1 channel. Premium: up to 3. More channels = more audience reach. Upgrade via /premium and connect additional channels from Connected Channel .

Q: How do I add more channels?
A: Upgrade to Premium to add more channels. Free plan allows 1 channel. See Premium for current limits.

## Raise Bots
URL: https://fastschedulebot.github.io/Fast-Schedule/help/a/limit_raise_bots.html

Free: 1 bot. Premium: 3 bots. Each bot serves one channel. To get more bots, upgrade to Premium.

Q: How do I raise my sender bot limit?
A: Upgrade to Premium to connect more sender bots. Free plan allows 1 bot. See Premium for current limits.

## Raise Send Limits
URL: https://fastschedulebot.github.io/Fast-Schedule/help/a/limit_raise_daily.html

Free plans can send up to 100 messages per channel per month . There is no daily cap. Premium removes the monthly cap completely - schedule and send as much as you need.

Q: How many messages can I send per month?
A: Free plan: 100 sent messages per channel per month. Premium: unlimited. There is no daily cap on either plan. See Plan Limits for exact numbers.

## Raise Storage
URL: https://fastschedulebot.github.io/Fast-Schedule/help/a/limit_raise_storage.html

Free: 1 box, 100 items. Premium: 20 boxes, unlimited items, videos allowed. Upgrade to Premium from /premium to unlock more storage for your media library.

Q: Can I raise my storage limit?
A: Yes — Premium increases storage box count and total items. See Media Storage for the current limits.

## What Do I Get With Fast Scheduler for Free? (Exact Limits)
URL: https://fastschedulebot.github.io/Fast-Schedule/help/a/qa_free_limits.html

Free is a real plan, not a trial — it never expires and has no daily caps. Here is exactly what you get, with numbers you can plan around. The numbers 1 channel with 1 sender bot . Up to 100 scheduled messages pending at once — your working queue. As posts go out, space frees up; this is not a monthly allowance. 100 sent messages per channel per calendar month — the actual sending quota. Resets on the 1st. 1 recurring message — one repeating rule (daily, weekly, every N hours…). Recurring rules on Free expire after 365 days and need re-confirming. Media Storage: 1 box with 100 items , no video in storage. Uploads up to 10 MB , videos up to 25MB. What “100/month per channel” means in practice If you post 3 times a day, that is ~90 posts a month — Free covers a light daily cadence on one channel. Posting 5+ times a day, or running several channels, is where Premium starts to make sense. The counter counts sends by the sender bot ; edits, previews and deleted schedules are free. There is no daily cap Older versions of the bot had daily limits; they are gone. On Free you can schedule and send every single day — the only quotas are the pending-queue size and the monthly send count. Check both any time with /stats . Hitting a limit gracefully The queue limit blocks new schedules, never deletes old ones; the monthly cap pauses sends until the 1st (the bot tells you). Both warn you in advance with clear messages and a one-tap upgrade path. Nothing is silently dropped.

Q: Do unused sends carry over to next month?
A: No. The monthly counter resets to zero on the 1st; unused sends do not roll over. The pending-queue space is also not a quota to “use up” — it just caps how far ahead you can stockpile.

Q: Is the free plan time-limited or feature-crippled?
A: It never expires. Scheduling, recurring, statistics, search and the calendar all work on Free. Premium removes quantity limits and adds the Export/Backup toolkit, signatures and bigger media.

Q: How do I check my current usage?
A: Send /stats. It shows your queue size, monthly sends, recurring rules and storage at a glance.

# Time Zone

## Time Zone
URL: https://fastschedulebot.github.io/Fast-Schedule/help/a/timezone.html



Q: How do timezones affect my schedule?
A: Each channel has its own timezone. Scheduling times are interpreted in that timezone.

Q: What happens if I change a channel's timezone?
A: Existing scheduled messages adjust to the new timezone.

Q: How do I find my timezone in the list?
A: Type part of your city or region name to filter. The list uses IANA timezone names (e.g., America/New_York, Europe/London, Asia/Tokyo).

## Set Time Zone
URL: https://fastschedulebot.github.io/Fast-Schedule/help/a/timezone_set.html

Set your time zone so the bot interprets scheduling times correctly. 1. Use /timezone (or find it in settings). 2. Choose from the list, search a city, or let the bot detect it from your location. Tip: every channel also has its own time zone. If a message posts at the wrong hour, check the channel's time zone setting.

## Supported Zones
URL: https://fastschedulebot.github.io/Fast-Schedule/help/a/timezone_list.html

All standard IANA time zones are supported - from UTC-12 to UTC+14, including half-hour and quarter-hour offsets. Search by city, country, or abbreviation (e.g. "Hanoi", "NYC", "CET"). The bot shows the current local time so you can verify the choice.

## Why Did My Post Go Out at the Wrong Time? Time Zones, Explained Simply
URL: https://fastschedulebot.github.io/Fast-Schedule/help/a/qa_timezones.html

“I scheduled 9:00 and it posted at 12:00” — before anything else, check which clock the number 9:00 belongs to. Fast Scheduler schedules posts in a time zone , and the zone that matters is the one set for the channel, not the one on your watch. How the bot decides “when 9:00 is” Every channel has a time zone setting . When you schedule 9:00, the bot stores 9:00 in the channel's zone and converts it to UTC behind the scenes. If the zone is UTC (the default) and you are in, say, New York, your 9:00 local is 13:00 or 14:00 UTC — the post will “move” by 4–5 hours from your point of view. Set the channel's zone to your own city once, and from then on 9:00 means your 9:00, every time. The daylight-saving trap Zones that observe DST shift twice a year. A post scheduled for 9:00 in March may land at 8:00 or 10:00 relative to the wall clock in November, depending on how the zone handles the shift. If your audience notices a one-hour drift in spring or autumn, that is why. The schedule did not break — the zone's definition of 9:00 changed. Reschedule around the shift week if you post at a strict local hour. Checking and fixing the zone Open Time Zone in the bot (or /timezone ), pick the channel, and choose the city/zone that matches your audience — the list uses proper zone names like Europe/Berlin , so DST is handled by the same rules your phone uses. Upcoming posts keep their stored times; only new schedules use the new zone, so double-check anything queued for the same day you change it. Quick diagnosis table Off by a whole number of hours, constant — wrong zone set for the channel. Off by one hour, only in spring/autumn — DST shift; the zone is working correctly. Off by a few minutes, growing over weeks — rare; send /feedback with two examples.

Q: Does changing the time zone move my scheduled posts?
A: No. Existing posts keep their stored times; the new zone applies to schedules you create afterwards. Verify the next few posts after changing the zone.

Q: What time zone should I pick for an international audience?
A: Pick the zone of your largest audience segment, or UTC if you think in UTC. Consistency matters more than the specific zone.

## Why Was My Scheduled Telegram Post Published at the Wrong Time?
URL: https://fastschedulebot.github.io/Fast-Schedule/help/a/qa_timezone_wrong_time.html

When a scheduled message fires at an unexpected hour, the clock itself is almost never wrong — the time zone used to interpret &ldquo;9:00&rdquo; is. Fast Scheduler resolves every time through two settings, and a mismatch between them explains nearly every &ldquo;wrong time&rdquo; report. The two clocks: user time zone and channel time zone Your user time zone — set once via /timezone and used whenever you type a time into the scheduling conversation. Each channel&rsquo;s own time zone — set per channel, because the audience that reads the channel may live in a different zone than you do. Schedules for that channel are interpreted in the channel&rsquo;s zone. If your user zone says UTC+3 but the channel zone says UTC+0, a message you schedule for 9:00 is stored as 9:00 channel time — and lands six hours earlier than you visually expected. Check both: /timezone for yourself, and the channel settings inside the bot for the channel. Daylight saving time Zones with DST shift by one hour twice a year. Fast Scheduler stores schedules in absolute terms, so a post that crossed a DST boundary can appear to &ldquo;move&rdquo; by an hour. If you live in a DST zone and noticed the shift right after the clocks changed, re-check the channel&rsquo;s zone — picking a zone like Europe/Berlin (which follows DST rules) versus a fixed UTC offset produces different results across the year. Quick diagnosis checklist Off by a round number of hours (3, 4, 6…) → time-zone mismatch; fix the channel time zone or your user zone. Off by exactly one hour right after late March / late October → DST; confirm the zone uses the right convention. AM/PM confusion — schedule with the 24-hour clock (14:00, not 2:00) to remove ambiguity entirely. Around midnight — double-check you scheduled the day you meant; the date picker always shows the resolved local date and time for final confirmation before saving. One more tip: the confirmation screen before saving shows the exact send time. Reading that single line — not the input you typed — is the ground truth for when the post will fire.

Q: Does each Telegram channel have its own time zone in Fast Scheduler?
A: Yes. Every channel carries its own time zone, and schedules for that channel are interpreted in the channel zone. Your personal /timezone setting applies to how you enter times while chatting with the bot.

Q: How do I change the time zone of a channel?
A: Open the bot, go to the channel settings, and set its time zone there. Existing scheduled messages keep their stored times, so new schedules pick up the change immediately.

# Language

## Language
URL: https://fastschedulebot.github.io/Fast-Schedule/help/a/language.html



Q: How do I disable language sync?
A: Go to Language on the main menu → tap Disable Language Sync . This stops cross-bot sync offers between Fast Scheduler and @SetDate_bot, and turns off Telegram language detection. You can re-enable it anytime from the same menu.

Q: How do I hide language sync notifications?
A: Premium feature. Go to Language on the main menu → tap Hide Notifications . Sync still works but you won't see the notification popups. Toggle it back to show notifications again.

## Change Language
URL: https://fastschedulebot.github.io/Fast-Schedule/help/a/language_change.html

1. Tap Language in the main menu (or use /language ). 2. Pick your language from the list. 3. The bot confirms and switches immediately. If a language isn't available yet, see Missing Language .

## Languages
URL: https://fastschedulebot.github.io/Fast-Schedule/help/a/language_list.html

The bot is available in the languages shown in the Language menu (English, and more being translated). English is always available as the fallback. If you spot mistakes in a translation, mention it via Feedback so it can be corrected.

## Missing Language?
URL: https://fastschedulebot.github.io/Fast-Schedule/help/a/language_add.html

The bot ships in several languages, and English is always available. If yours isn't in the list yet: Check the full list Open Language (or /language ) and scroll — the menu shows every currently supported language, and new ones are added over time. Request a translation Ask via Feedback in the bot or write to @MaximalXP and tell us which language you need. Popular requests get prioritised. In the meantime • English commands like /schedule and /list work no matter which language is active. • Your channel content is never translated — only the bot's interface language changes. • @SetDate_bot shares your language preference, so both bots switch together once your language is added.

# Export

## Export
URL: https://fastschedulebot.github.io/Fast-Schedule/help/a/export.html

Export your data as a downloadable file. Choose what to export (scheduled, recurring, all) and a format: • .txt - plain text, human-readable. • .csv - spreadsheet, opens in Excel/Sheets. • .json - structured data for developers. For a complete backup with restore, use /backup instead.

## Export Data
URL: https://fastschedulebot.github.io/Fast-Schedule/help/a/export_data.html

From Export (or /export ) you can export: • Scheduled messages - content, times, channels. • Recurring messages - schedule rules and content. • Everything in one file. Pick the format and the bot sends the file to your chat.

## Export a Chat
URL: https://fastschedulebot.github.io/Fast-Schedule/help/a/export_chat.html

Export your scheduled and recurring content for a specific channel to see exactly what's planned there. Useful when handing a channel over to a teammate or archiving a campaign. The export file lists each message with its time and content.

## Formats
URL: https://fastschedulebot.github.io/Fast-Schedule/help/a/export_formats.html

Available formats: • .txt - plain text • .csv - spreadsheet • .json - structured data • .rtf / .odt - word processor Choose whichever fits how you'll use the file.

## Plain Text
URL: https://fastschedulebot.github.io/Fast-Schedule/help/a/export_text.html

A .txt export writes each message as readable text, one after another - easy to review, copy, or reuse. Message blocks are separated by blank lines so the file can be re-imported as multiple messages.

## CSV Export
URL: https://fastschedulebot.github.io/Fast-Schedule/help/a/export_csv.html

CSV exports open in Excel, Google Sheets, and other spreadsheet tools. Columns include channel, date/time, content, and media info. Perfect for planning and reporting in a spreadsheet.

## JSON Export
URL: https://fastschedulebot.github.io/Fast-Schedule/help/a/export_json.html

JSON export keeps the full structured data of your messages, settings, and media references. Aimed at developers and tools that process schedules programmatically. JSON import supports the same structure.

## RTF Export
URL: https://fastschedulebot.github.io/Fast-Schedule/help/a/export_rtf.html

RTF (Rich Text Format) keeps simple formatting and opens in most word processors. Good for producing a nicely formatted copy of your schedule that you can share or print.

## ODT Export
URL: https://fastschedulebot.github.io/Fast-Schedule/help/a/export_odt.html

ODT is the open-document text format used by LibreOffice and OpenOffice. Use it when you need an editable, standard text file for documents.

# Import

## Import
URL: https://fastschedulebot.github.io/Fast-Schedule/help/a/import.html



Q: Can I import messages in bulk?
A: Yes! Send a .txt file where each message is separated by a blank line. All messages will be imported with the same date/time. You can then edit each one individually.

Q: What formats are supported for import?
A: Supported formats: .txt, .csv, .json, .rtf, .odt, .fsback (full backup), .fspback (password-protected backup).

## Importing Your Data
URL: https://fastschedulebot.github.io/Fast-Schedule/help/a/import_data.html

Import brings messages back into the scheduler from a file — the mirror image of Export. How to import 1. Open Data → Import (or send /import ). 2. Send the file: a .fsback / .fspback backup, a .txt message list, a .csv spreadsheet, or a SetDate schedule. 3. For password-protected backups, enter the password when asked. 4. Confirm — full backups restore with an Overwrite or Add choice. Two kinds of import • Backup restore (from your own /backup files): everything comes back — scheduled and recurring messages, settings, channels, bots, media boxes. Overwrite replaces the current data; Add merges on top of it. • Message lists ( .txt / .csv / SetDate): each block or row becomes a scheduled message in your connected channel , so make sure the channel is connected before you start. Before you confirm A full restore with Overwrite replaces your current data. If in doubt, run /export first (Premium) so you always have a way back.

## Import a Chat
URL: https://fastschedulebot.github.io/Fast-Schedule/help/a/import_chat.html

Import messages for your chat from a .txt or .csv file. Each message block becomes a scheduled message. In the import options you can pick which channel to target. This is handy for migrating content from another bot or a prepared spreadsheet.

## Import From Storage
URL: https://fastschedulebot.github.io/Fast-Schedule/help/a/import_from_storage.html

When building schedules in SetDate or bulk import, you can attach media from your storage library. In the import flow, pick media from storage to attach to imported messages - useful when your spreadsheet references file names that exist in your storage boxes. This keeps your content consistent without re-uploading files.

## CSV Import
URL: https://fastschedulebot.github.io/Fast-Schedule/help/a/import_csv.html

CSV import turns a spreadsheet into scheduled messages — perfect for content plans prepared in Excel or Google Sheets. The format The file needs two columns: Date/Time and Content . Export your sheet as CSV (UTF-8) and send it to the bot during the import flow. Each row becomes one scheduled message; the date column accepts the same formats the bot accepts when typing (for example 25.12.2025 10:00 ). Where messages land Rows are imported into your connected channel — the import targets it directly, there is no channel picker. Times are interpreted in the channel's time zone. Tips for clean imports • Keep one message per row; put line breaks inside the Content cell. • Test with a two-row file first, review the result in the Message List, then import the full sheet. • Need richer structure (multiple channels, media)? Use .txt blocks or a full backup restore instead.

## JSON Import
URL: https://fastschedulebot.github.io/Fast-Schedule/help/a/import_json.html

JSON import restores structured exports — including the exports made by this bot. Send the .json file during the import flow (Data → Import, or /import ). The bot reads each record and recreates the scheduled message: text, date, and channel reference. If the file was exported from a different setup, messages land in your currently connected channel. Prefer a complete snapshot restore — settings, bots, recurring messages and all? A .fsback backup restore is the right tool; JSON is for message-level transfers.

## Supported Import Formats
URL: https://fastschedulebot.github.io/Fast-Schedule/help/a/import_formats.html

The import flow accepts: • .fsback / .fspback — full bot backups (restore with Overwrite or Add). • .txt — message lists; a blank line starts a new message, with the date on its own line (see the Format topic). • .csv — spreadsheets with Date/Time and Content columns. • SetDate files — schedules generated by @SetDate_bot, imported as-is. • .json — structured exports. Everything except full backups imports into your connected channel, in the channel's time zone. Connect the channel first, then import.

# Backup

## Backup
URL: https://fastschedulebot.github.io/Fast-Schedule/help/a/backup.html



Q: How do I export my data?
A: Step by step: 1. Click Export on the main menu (page 2) or use /export 2. Choose what to export: Scheduled Messages , Recurring Messages , or Media Storage 3. Choose format: • .txt — plain text, human-readable • .csv — spreadsheet (opens in Excel/Google Sheets) • .json — structured data for developers 4. The file is sent to you as a document For a full backup (Premium): use /backup → choose password protection (optional) → the .fsback file is sent to you. To restore: use /import and send the .fsback file.

Q: How do I restore a backup?
A: Step by step: 1. Click Import on the main menu (page 2) or use /import 2. Send the backup file (.fsback or .fspback) 3. If password-protected, enter the password when prompted 4. The bot restores all your data — messages, channels, bots, settings 5. You'll get a confirmation when done Note: Restoring a backup replaces your current data. Make sure to export your current data first if you want to keep it.

Q: Can I set up automatic backups?
A: Automatic backups are not available as a built-in feature yet. However, you can manually export anytime: • Use /export for selective export (scheduled, recurring, or media) • Use /backup for a full backup (Premium, can be password-protected) Recommendation: export your data regularly, especially before making big changes.

Q: How do I create a password-protected backup?
A: Premium feature. Step by step: 1. Use /backup command 2. When prompted, choose Enable Password Protection 3. Enter a password (you'll need this to restore later — don't forget it!) 4. The .fspback file is generated and sent to you 5. To restore: use /import → send the .fspback file → enter the password Warning: Without the password, the backup cannot be restored. Keep your password safe!

Q: What's included in a full backup?
A: A full backup (.fsback / .fspback) includes: all scheduled messages (text, media, settings), all recurring messages, media storage items and boxes, channel connections and settings, bot tokens and assignments, user preferences (language, timezone), and referral data. Everything needed to restore your account to exactly the same state.

Q: What's the difference between .fsback and .fspback?
A: .fsback is a standard full backup (no password). .fspback is a password-protected backup with encryption (Premium only). Both contain the same data, but .fspback requires a password to restore. To create a .fspback: use /backup → choose password protection → enter your password.

## Create Backup
URL: https://fastschedulebot.github.io/Fast-Schedule/help/a/backup_create.html

1. Use /backup . 2. Choose whether to protect it with a password. 3. The bot generates and sends the .fsback file. A full backup includes scheduled and recurring messages, settings, connections, and media references - everything needed to restore your account. Backups are a Premium feature.

## What Is Backed Up
URL: https://fastschedulebot.github.io/Fast-Schedule/help/a/backup_include.html

A full backup includes: • Scheduled and recurring messages (content, times, media refs) • Connected channels and sender bot assignments • Settings (language, time zone, signatures) • Media storage items and boxes • Referral and promo data Basically everything needed to restore the same account.

## What Is Excluded
URL: https://fastschedulebot.github.io/Fast-Schedule/help/a/backup_exclude.html

A backup does not include: • Files/media binary themselves for large uploads are re-verified on restore where needed. • Data of other users. • Server logs or internal state. If something can't be included, the backup report tells you.

## Backup Password
URL: https://fastschedulebot.github.io/Fast-Schedule/help/a/backup_password.html

Protect your backup with a password ( /backup → enable password). The file becomes encrypted (.fspback) and requires the password to restore. Warning: without the password, the backup cannot be restored. Store it somewhere you won't lose it.

## Backup Size
URL: https://fastschedulebot.github.io/Fast-Schedule/help/a/backup_size.html

Backup file size depends on your data volume: number of messages, media references, and settings. Text-based backups are small. Media is stored as references (files are re-uploaded), keeping the backup compact.

## Scheduled Backups
URL: https://fastschedulebot.github.io/Fast-Schedule/help/a/backup_schedule.html

Automatic recurring backups aren't a feature yet. Instead, export regularly yourself: • /backup for a full snapshot. • /export for quick selective exports. A good habit: backup before big changes or after major campaigns.

## Restore Backup
URL: https://fastschedulebot.github.io/Fast-Schedule/help/a/backup_restore.html

1. Use /import . 2. Send the .fsback / .fspback file. 3. If password-protected, enter the password. 4. Confirm - the bot restores your data. Important: restoring replaces your current data. Export before restoring if you want to keep both.

## Verify
URL: https://fastschedulebot.github.io/Fast-Schedule/help/a/backup_verify.html

After creating a backup, keep it safe and test it: • Export once, then import it into a fresh setup to confirm it restores. • Ensure the file isn't corrupted (it should open as expected). Regular test-restores ensure you can recover if something goes wrong.

## Cloud
URL: https://fastschedulebot.github.io/Fast-Schedule/help/a/backup_cloud.html

Store your backup files in cloud storage (Google Drive, Dropbox, etc.) so they survive device loss. Telegram documents stay available for a long time, but a separate backup is the safest option. Keep the password for .fspback files in a password manager.

## Download
URL: https://fastschedulebot.github.io/Fast-Schedule/help/a/backup_download.html

The backup file is sent to you as a document in the chat. Save it somewhere safe (cloud drive, computer, another device). Telegram does not keep your bot data forever - your downloaded backup is the guarantee you can always recover.

## What Is the Difference Between .fsback and .fspback?
URL: https://fastschedulebot.github.io/Fast-Schedule/help/a/qa_fsback_vs_fspback.html

Short answer: both are the same complete backup — the only difference is the password . A .fspback file is a password-protected .fsback file. The extra “p” stands for protected . What each format is .fsback — a full backup of your Fast Scheduler data with no password . Anyone who gets the file can restore it, so treat it like a plain-text secret. .fspback — the same backup, encrypted . Restoring asks for the password you set when creating it. Without the password the data inside cannot be read. When you tap Create Backup (or send /backup ), the bot asks whether you want password protection. Choosing no password produces .fsback ; setting a password (and an optional hint) produces .fspback . A Premium feature — backups are part of the Export &amp; Backup toolkit that unlocks with Premium. What is inside either file Both formats package your selected data — scheduled messages, recurring messages, settings, and more — into one archive you can download, store in the cloud, or move to another account. Media you saved in Media Storage is referenced, not re-uploaded, so files stay small. Which one should you pick? Restoring to your own account right now? .fsback is fine and faster to use. Keeping the file long-term, sending it to a teammate, or migrating to a new phone? .fspback — the password protects your scheduled content from strangers. Restoring a file Send /import to the bot, attach the .fsback or .fspback file, enter the password if asked, then choose Overwrite (replace current data) or Add (merge with current data). Export a fresh backup before you overwrite anything.

Q: Is .fspback more secure than .fsback?
A: Yes. A .fspback file is encrypted with the password you set; a .fsback file is not protected at all. If the backup contains bot tokens or private content, prefer .fspback.

Q: I lost the password to my .fspback file. Can it be recovered?
A: No. The password cannot be reset or bypassed — not even by support. Keep the password (and the hint you optionally set) together with the file. Without it the backup is unreadable.

Q: Can I convert .fsback to .fspback (or back)?
A: Indirectly: restore the .fsback file into your account, then create a new backup and choose password protection to get a .fspback file. There is no direct file-conversion command.

Q: Which formats can I import besides these?
A: Imports also accept .json, .csv, .txt, .rtf and .odt files (and SetDate bundles). Those carry messages only, while .fsback/.fspback carry your full configuration.

## How to Back Up All Scheduled Posts in Telegram (and Restore Them Anywhere)
URL: https://fastschedulebot.github.io/Fast-Schedule/help/a/qa_backup_full_guide.html

Rebuilding a month of scheduled posts by hand is nobody's idea of fun. Fast Scheduler's backup system exists so you never have to: one file captures everything, and restoring it on any account takes about a minute. What a backup contains A .fsback / .fspback file packages the parts of your account you select — typically: Scheduled messages — every queued post with its exact send time. Recurring messages — repeat rules (daily, weekly, custom intervals) and their expiry settings. Settings — language, time zone, signatures, channel preferences. Media Storage references — saved photos, videos and documents with their boxes. What is not included: user backups exclude sender-bot tokens, and payment history never leaves Telegram's systems. The export screen lets you review what goes into the file before you confirm. Creating a backup — step by step Backups are a Premium feature. With Premium active: 1. Open the menu → Data → Export (or send /backup ). 2. Pick what to include (scheduled, recurring, all). 3. Choose password protection : none for .fsback , or set a password + hint for .fspback . 4. The bot packs the archive and sends the file. Save it somewhere real — cloud drive, local disk, anywhere that survives losing your phone. Restoring — the safe way Send /import , attach the file, enter the password if prompted. The bot then asks how to apply it: Overwrite — replaces your current data with the backup's content. Anything not in the backup disappears. Add — merges the backup into your current data, keeping what you already have. Golden rule: export a fresh backup before restoring an older one. It is your undo button if the result surprises you. Good backup habits Take a fresh backup before deleting a channel, rotating a bot, or bulk-editing posts. Keep at least one .fspback with a strong password — shared drives get opened by more people than you think. After switching phones or accounts, restore + verify the Message List before the real posting week starts.

Q: Is backup free or Premium?
A: Creating .fsback/.fspback backups is part of the Export & Backup toolkit, which requires Premium. Importing files (/import) works on Free, so anyone can restore a backup received from someone else.

Q: Where should I store the backup file?
A: Anywhere outside Telegram: a cloud drive, your computer, or an encrypted notes app. Telegram keeps the file in your chat too, but Saved Messages is not a backup strategy.

Q: How big is a backup file?
A: Small — usually kilobytes to a few megabytes, because media is referenced rather than embedded. Text and schedules compress extremely well.

Q: Can I move my schedules to another Telegram account?
A: Yes. Create a backup on the old account, log into the new one, connect the channel and a sender bot, then restore the backup with Add mode. This is the standard migration path.

# Media Storage

## Media Storage
URL: https://fastschedulebot.github.io/Fast-Schedule/help/a/media_storage.html



Q: How do I create a storage box and save media?
A: Step by step: 1. Click Media Storage on the main menu (page 2) or use /storage 2. Click Create Box 3. Enter a name for your box (e.g., "Product Photos") 4. The box is created — now click on it to open it 5. Send photos, videos, or files to the bot — they'll be saved in this box 6. Later, when scheduling a message, choose From Storage as the media option and pick from your collection Free plan: 1 box, max 100 items, no videos. Premium: up to 20 boxes, 500 items.

Q: How do I rename or delete a storage box?
A: To rename : click Media Storage → select the box → click Rename → type the new name → confirm. To delete : click Media Storage → select the box → click Delete Box → confirm deletion. Warning: Deleting a box removes ALL media inside it permanently.

Q: Can I move items between storage boxes?
A: Yes. Step by step: 1. Click Media Storage → open the source box 2. Use Move All or Copy All (optionally filtered by type: images, videos, files) 3. Choose the destination box from the list 4. The items are moved/copied — no need to re-upload This helps you reorganize your media collection without re-uploading anything.

Q: What happens to my storage when Premium expires?
A: On the first day after expiry, you'll get a prompt to choose 1 storage box to keep . If you don't choose, the newest box is kept by default. Excess boxes are deleted after 17 days. The kept box is trimmed to 100 newest items (videos are kept first, then newest by date). To avoid this: reactivate Premium with /premium before day 17.

Q: Can I store videos in Media Storage?
A: Free plan: No in storage — you'll get an error if you try. Premium: up to 50MB per video. Videos larger than the premium limit cannot be saved to storage even on Premium. To check your plan: use /premium or click Premium on the main menu.

Q: How do I delete individual items from storage?
A: Step by step: 1. Click Media Storage on the main menu (or use /storage ) 2. Select the storage box containing the items 3. Browse the list of media items 4. Click on an item → click Delete 5. Confirm deletion — this is permanent and cannot be undone To delete everything: use Delete Box to remove the entire box and all contents.

Q: Can I preview media before selecting it for a message?
A: Yes! When scheduling a message and you reach the media step: 1. Choose From Storage 2. Select a storage box 3. Each item shows a preview — you can see the image/video before picking it 4. Click on the one you want → it's attached to your scheduled message 5. Confirm and your message is ready with the selected media

## When to Use Storage
URL: https://fastschedulebot.github.io/Fast-Schedule/help/a/storage_use_case.html

Use media storage when you: • Post the same photos/videos repeatedly (products, headers, promos). • Want consistent branding across posts. • Build schedules in bulk and need media without re-uploading. For one-off posts, just attach media directly during scheduling.

Q: When is media storage useful?
A: Whenever you reuse visuals — promo banners, cover images, or recurring content. Save once, then attach to any scheduled message without re-uploading.

## Storage Boxes
URL: https://fastschedulebot.github.io/Fast-Schedule/help/a/ms_boxes.html

Your media is organized into boxes (storages). Each box holds photos, videos, and documents you can reuse in schedules. Free plan: 1 box up to 100 items. Premium: up to 20 boxes, unlimited items. Open Storage from the main menu to see your boxes.

Q: How do I create a storage box?
A: Open Media Storage , tap Create Box , give it a name, then save media into it directly from the schedule flow. Free plan allows 1 (max 100) box.

## Create a Box
URL: https://fastschedulebot.github.io/Fast-Schedule/help/a/ms_create.html

A box is your reusable media library. Fill one with photos, videos or files, then pick From Storage while scheduling and the bot attaches media for you — even randomly. How to create: 1. Open Storage from the main menu. 2. Tap ➕ Add Storage . 3. Give the box a name and send it. Free: 1 box. Premium: up to 20 boxes — great for organizing media by campaign, product, or channel.

## Rename Box
URL: https://fastschedulebot.github.io/Fast-Schedule/help/a/ms_rename.html

Rename any storage box to keep your library tidy (e.g. "Products", "Screenshots"). Storage → open the box → rename.

## Archive
URL: https://fastschedulebot.github.io/Fast-Schedule/help/a/ms_archive.html

Archive boxes you no longer use actively - they stay saved but out of the way. Archived boxes don't count against your active box quota in the free plan view and can be unarchived anytime.

## Quota
URL: https://fastschedulebot.github.io/Fast-Schedule/help/a/ms_quota.html

Your storage quota is the total of your boxes: free 100 items; Premium unlimited across 20 boxes. The storage menu shows how full you are. Delete unused items to free up space on the free plan.

## Preview
URL: https://fastschedulebot.github.io/Fast-Schedule/help/a/ms_preview.html

Preview any stored item before using it - check the image, video frame, or document title. Previewing avoids picking the wrong file in your schedules.

## Manage Box
