# Settings & Configuration

## Settings & Configuration
URL: https://fastschedulebot.github.io/Fast-Schedule/help/a/config.html

Configure Fast Scheduler to work exactly how you want. Language • Use /language or tap Language on the main menu • Choose from available languages • Changes sync with @SetDate_bot (you'll be asked to confirm) • See Language help topic for details about sync, disabling, and hiding notifications Timezone • Use /timezone to set your timezone • Set per-channel timezones for multi-channel users • Supports city search, location detection, and manual offset • Messages are scheduled in your local time • See Timezone help topic for details Signature • Premium feature — add a signature to your messages • Choose position (start/end) and blank lines before it • Preview before saving • See Signature help topic for details Default Channel • Set a default channel in channel settings to skip the channel picker • Each channel can have its own timezone • Manage connected channels with /channel Commands • See Commands Overview for the full command list • Most features are accessible via both commands and buttons Language Sync • Language is shared between @FastSchedulerBot and @SetDate_bot • Can be disabled entirely in the Language menu • Anyone can disable sync entirely in the Language menu Managing Multiple Channels & Bots • Connect up to 1 channel (3 on Premium) • Connect up to 1 sender bot (3 on Premium) • Each channel can use a different sender bot • See relevant help topics for details

Q: Where are the settings?
A: There is no single Settings button. Each setting is accessible from its own menu or command: • /language — change language • /timezone — set timezone • /signature — manage signature (Premium) • /channel — manage channels and default channel • /commands — list all available commands Settings are also available from the main menu buttons.

Q: How do I set a Default Channel?
A: Go to Connected Channels → tap a channel → Set as Default . Once set, scheduling new messages skips the channel picker and uses your default channel directly.

Q: Can I use different timezones for different channels?
A: Yes. Use /timezone and then select a specific channel to set its timezone independently. Each channel's scheduled messages will use its own timezone.

## Signatures (Premium)
URL: https://fastschedulebot.github.io/Fast-Schedule/help/a/signature.html

Add a custom signature — for example "Posted by @yourbot" — to every post on the channels you choose. How to set up: 1. Tap 📝 Signature on the main menu or send /signature. 2. Use Add Signature and send your signature text (bold, italic, code and links work). 3. Pick the position — start or end of the post — and how many blank lines separate it. 4. Enable auto-add and select the channels it should attach to; or add it per message from the signature list. Good to know: • Signatures are appended at send time — your stored messages stay clean. • They never take over your inline button rows. • Free users can try signatures once; after that it is a Premium feature. When Premium expires: auto-add stops once Premium is gone, and signature settings are deleted when the expiry process fully completes. Reactivate Premium to keep everything.

## How to Add an Automatic Signature to Every Telegram Post
URL: https://fastschedulebot.github.io/Fast-Schedule/help/a/qa_signature_guide.html

A signature is the footer that appears under every post in a channel: credit, CTA, hashtags, promo. Set it once in Fast Scheduler and every scheduled message carries it — you stop copy-pasting “@yourchannel” to the end of everything. Setting it up 1. Open Signature via /signature (or tap 📝 Signature on the review screen). Premium feature. 2. Pick the channel — signatures are per channel , so your main channel can carry a promo while the announcements channel stays clean. 3. Send the text. Formatting works: bold , italic , links, even emoji-free minimalism if that is your style. From the next send onward, the signature is appended to every post in that channel. Existing scheduled posts pick it up automatically at send time — no need to reschedule anything. What belongs in a good signature The channel handle — the classic “@yourchannel” line, since forwarded copies keep the credit. One action — “Reply to buy”, “Details: link”. A signature with three CTAs has zero. Hashtags for navigation — if the channel uses tag-indexing, the signature is the perfect place for the constant ones. Changing and removing The same menu edits or clears the signature; clearing stops appending immediately (again, applied at send time, so posts already published keep their footer — that is a feature, not a bug). Per-channel control means experimenting is cheap.

Q: Can I use different signatures for different channels?
A: Yes — signatures are configured per channel. Each connected channel gets its own text (or none).

Q: Does the signature count toward the message length?
A: It is part of the final message text, so extremely long signatures can hit Telegram’s 4096-character limit on top of long posts. Short signatures are better anyway.

# More topics

## Signature Position
URL: https://fastschedulebot.github.io/Fast-Schedule/help/a/channel_signature_position.html

Choose where the signature appears in the sent message: • At the end (default) - classic sign-off under the content. • At the start - the signature line first, then your content. You can also add blank lines before the signature so it is visually separated from the message body. Preview before saving to see the result.

## Copying Items Between Boxes
URL: https://fastschedulebot.github.io/Fast-Schedule/help/a/ms_copy.html

Copy places a duplicate of an item into another box while the original stays where it is — unlike Move, which relocates the item. When copying beats moving • A logo that belongs to several campaign boxes at once. • Seasonal collections that share evergreen assets. • A "favourites" box that mirrors items from working boxes. Copies are independent: editing or deleting one copy never affects the other, and every schedule that references either box keeps working.

## Delete Media
URL: https://fastschedulebot.github.io/Fast-Schedule/help/a/ms_delete.html

Remove items from a box with the delete action. Careful: deleting media from a box doesn't delete scheduled messages that used it - those are converted to text-only instead of failing.

## Stored Documents
URL: https://fastschedulebot.github.io/Fast-Schedule/help/a/ms_document_storage.html

Documents (PDF, DOCX, etc.) can be saved to storage and reused. Unlike photos/videos, documents are stored without compression, so sizes add up - mind your plan's storage limits.

## Move Media
URL: https://fastschedulebot.github.io/Fast-Schedule/help/a/ms_move.html

Move items between your boxes to reorganize your library. Pick the item → Move → choose the destination box. The media is relocated; schedules referencing it keep working.

## Stored Photos
URL: https://fastschedulebot.github.io/Fast-Schedule/help/a/ms_photo.html

Photos in storage can be reused in any scheduled message via From Storage . Photos are compressed on upload (see Media Compression). Free plan stores up to 100 items total across your box.

## Replace Media
URL: https://fastschedulebot.github.io/Fast-Schedule/help/a/ms_replace.html

Replace a stored file with a new version while keeping its name and position. Schedules that use this media automatically use the new file from then on.

## Stored Videos
URL: https://fastschedulebot.github.io/Fast-Schedule/help/a/ms_video.html

Videos in storage are a Premium feature. Store videos up to 50MB and reuse them in schedules. Videos are compressed to keep storage reasonable. Free accounts cannot add videos to storage.

## Scheduling Time Zone
URL: https://fastschedulebot.github.io/Fast-Schedule/help/a/schedule_timezone.html

Every date/time you enter is interpreted in the channel's time zone , not necessarily yours. Set or check the channel's time zone: Channels → select the channel → Time Zone . If your messages seem to post at the wrong hour, this is almost always the cause - update the time zone and re-schedule.
